description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1793/3 of 15.01.2013 by adding new sport/Sport class, 'Modern Pentathlon'
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which involves the amendment of a regulatory schedule by adding a new sport/sport class. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legislation, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the primary focus is on regulatory amendment rather than government structure or personnel.
